dos: Recursively copy values and replace sensitive fields with the fixed [REDACTED] marker.
Safely handle nested objects, arrays, Errors, null-prototype objects, cycles, throwing accessors, and hostile objects.
Check standard Error fields name, message, and stack against the sensitive-key policy before copying their values.
Detect cycles without preserving non-cyclic shared-reference identity; copy repeated references independently.
Bound traversal by maxDepth, maxKeys, and maxArray, and emit [TRUNCATED] when a limit is reached.
Omit accessor-backed object properties without invoking getters.
Limit maxKeys to copied output properties, while acknowledging that own-key enumeration materializes a temporary key list.
Reduce hostile array operations that do not produce an array to an empty safe result; represent individual child failures as [UNSERIALIZABLE] while retaining other safe items.
For non-plain built-ins such as Date, Map, and Set, copy enumerable own properties when available without reconstructing internal built-in state.
donts: Do not invoke accessors during structured redaction.
Do not promise maxKeys bounds temporary memory used to enumerate an object's own keys.
Do not promise preservation of non-plain built-in internal state; use safeSerialize when callers need safe representations of those values.
